title: When Your Phone Hits 1% 🔋
description: Sunny's phone is dying and he handles it with total calm. Totally. Calm.

beats.line: One percent battery. Okay. Stay calm. Stay calm!
Where is the charger? It was right here!
Brightness down. Apps closed. Airplane mode. I am a genius.
Found it! Plugged in! Victory dance!
Wait. The plug was never in the wall.
